name: Cidero & Co.
description: Premium enrichment products designed specifically for indoor cats — interactive aquarium lamps, motion-activated fish and gecko toys, kickers and tunnels — sold direct from its own store since 2023, with 10k+ units sold. Its affiliate page invites cat influencers to earn a flat 20% commission per sale and states plainly that affiliates earn on every referred sale with no caps.

evidence.summary: Cidero & Co.'s own affiliate page fetched in full: '20% Commission Per Sale', '30-Day Cookie', 'PayPal Payouts', '10k+ Units Sold', and under 20% Commission: 'One of the most generous payouts in the cat niche. Earn on every referred sale with no caps.' The explicit no-caps earnings statement sits on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped. Applications run through a partner portal on UpPromote (the page's Join button links to af.uppromote.com) and are reviewed within 48 hours; affiliates get a personal link plus a custom discount code. The page is aimed squarely at cat creators on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and blogs. No creator count is published, so saturation stays unknown. Country is recorded as the brand's primary market (USD storefront); the brand sells globally and does not publish an HQ address on the fetched pages.

opportunity.title: Cidero & Co. Affiliate Program — brand's own page publishes 20% per sale 'with no caps' for cat creators

reasons.niche_fit: A single-species, single-setting niche (indoor cats) is exactly the kind of focused audience UGC creators build channels around.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program page is written for cat influencers and names Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and blogs as the intended channels, with complimentary products for top ambassadors.
reasons.compensation: 20% per sale is at the top of the pet-products range, it is verified uncapped on the brand's own page, and payouts are by PayPal with no stated minimum.
reasons.contact_access: Open application on the brand's own page with a stated 48-hour review; no published email, so access runs through the portal only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live and recruiting now, with applications reviewed within 48 hours and links issued on approval.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2023 with 10k+ units sold claimed on its own page; a young, small brand, so a point is held back versus established names.

name: LibertyPaw
description: Family-owned retailer of American-made pet products — toys, gear, grooming tools, beds and supplements, all made in the USA — run from St. Petersburg, Florida. Its Brand Ambassador Program is built specifically for pet Instagram and TikTok creators and pays 10% commission on most products (5% on K9 dryers, dog beds and crate pads) through UpPromote, with a 30-day cookie.

evidence.summary: LibertyPaw's own affiliate page fetched in full, including its Program Rules (last updated November 6, 2026): sign-up, tracking and payouts are handled through UpPromote; commission is 10% on eligible products and 5% on K-9 dryers, dog beds and crate pads, calculated after discounts; links track purchases within 30 days; commissions are paid by PayPal or check after a 35-day holding period. Eligibility is creator-specific: a real, active pet account on Instagram or TikTok with at least 2,500 genuine followers, posting at least 3 times a week, 18+, US-based. The page publishes ambassador@libertypaw.com and shop@libertypaw.com and the company address in St. Petersburg, FL. No earnings-cap statement and no creator count are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

opportunity.title: LibertyPaw Brand Ambassador Program — 10% commission for pet Instagram/TikTok creators, tracked via UpPromote

reasons.niche_fit: Made-in-USA pet gear is a clear, filmable angle for pet creators, and the catalog (toys, gear, grooming, supplements) suits everyday pet content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is explicitly built for pet Instagram accounts and TikTok creators, with follower and posting-frequency requirements written into its rules.
reasons.compensation: 10% on most products is mid-range for pet retail; the 5% tier on dryers, beds and crate pads and the 35-day hold keep it below the top scorers.
reasons.contact_access: Two published emails (ambassador@ and shop@), a phone number and a street address on the program page — well above the norm.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open now but gated: 2,500+ genuine followers, 3 posts a week and US residency are hard requirements, which narrows who can take it up.
reasons.credibility: Family-owned, publishes its address, rules and a 30-Day Happiness Guarantee; a small brand, so not full marks.

name: Pawganix
description: Pet supplement brand built around the gut-skin connection: YeastGuard and MoveGuard daily chews for dogs and the CalmGuard pheromone calming kit for cats. Its Pawganix Pro creator program pays 20% of a new customer's first order and 10% of that customer's reorders and subscription renewals for 12 months, with a 90-day click window, free product to film and no follower minimum.

evidence.summary: Pawganix's own Pawganix Pro creator page fetched in full: '20% of a new customer's first order through your link, then 10% of their reorders and subscription renewals for 12 months. Free product to film, and every click is credited to you for 90 days.' No follower minimum, no content quotas, no contract or exclusivity; applications are read by a person and answered within two working days; pay is monthly by PayPal or bank transfer with an itemised statement. The recorded 20% is the first-order rate; the 10% reorder rate and 12-month tail are documented here rather than blended. No earnings-cap statement and no creator count are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown. Country is recorded from the brand's own British-English programme pages; the storefront prices in USD and sells internationally.

opportunity.title: Pawganix Pro for Creators — 20% on first orders plus a 10% reorder tail for 12 months, no follower minimum

reasons.niche_fit: Problem-led pet supplements (itchy yeasty dogs, joint support, cat calming) are natural before/after UGC material for dog and cat creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator programme with free product to film, no scripts or quotas, and named creator support — built for UGC rather than adapted from a publisher program.
reasons.compensation: 20% on first orders plus 10% on reorders for a full year is a strong structure; held below the top band because the reorder rate halves and no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Application form on the brand's own page with a named human reviewer and a two-working-day reply promise; no published email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to dog and cat creators of any size right now, with product shipped on approval — nothing about it is invite-only.
reasons.credibility: A young, small brand with a few hundred published reviews (4.88 average from 291 on its own groomer page); supplement claims are carefully hedged on its pages, but the track record is short.

name: Clear Drop
description: Maker of home pre-recycling appliances: the Soft Plastic Compactor (SPC), which presses soft plastics into dense recyclable blocks against a $200 deposit, and the Organics Collector (OC), an odor-neutralizing food-waste collector. Its affiliate program runs on Awin at a standard 15% commission and expressly welcomes content creators, influencers, communities and UGC partners.

evidence.summary: Clear Drop's official Awin program terms fetched in full (last updated 09 Dec 2025): 'Standard commission rate is 15%. It applies on $200 SPC deposit, full price for OC. It doesn't apply on consumables (filters, mailers).' Commissions are approved after a 30-day return period and paid via Awin. The terms' allowed partner types expressly include 'Content creators and influencers', 'Communities and UGC' and 'Social traffic'. The same page publishes the affiliate contact marketing@onecleardrop.com. No earnings-cap statement and no creator count appear in the terms, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

opportunity.title: Clear Drop Affiliate Program on Awin — 15% standard commission on home pre-recycling appliances, creators expressly allowed

reasons.niche_fit: A first-of-its-kind home appliance with a visible, satisfying transformation (loose soft plastic in, dense block out) is strong demo content for home and sustainability creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin terms expressly allow content creators, influencers, communities and UGC partner types — creator eligibility is documented, though the program is network-run rather than creator-branded.
reasons.compensation: 15% is a healthy rate for a home appliance, and it applies to the full OC price and the SPC deposit; consumables are excluded, which trims repeat-purchase earnings.
reasons.contact_access: A published affiliate contact email (marketing@onecleardrop.com) inside the official program terms, plus Awin's standard publisher route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live on Awin and open to applications now, subject to brand approval as the terms state.
reasons.credibility: Registered trademarks, detailed published terms and branding rules suggest an organised operator; still a young niche brand, so a point is held back.

name: Cat Person

Its affiliate program runs on Impact and pays 12–15% on one-time purchases, with subscription trials paying $8 plus 15%, on a 30-day cookie.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's Cat Person listing (fetched) records: 'Commission: 12%-15% per one-time sale, $8, 15% per subscription trial' on the Impact platform. Meer's World's pet-program roundup independently reports the same structure — 12% to 15% for one-time purchases, $8.00/15% for subscription trials, 30-day cookie, powered by Impact Radius, US service area. Because the published rate is a range, the recorded 12 is its floor, with the full structure documented here. Neither source publishes an earnings-cap statement or a creator count, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

opportunity.title: Cat Person Affiliate Program on Impact — 12–15% on one-time sales, $8 + 15% on subscription trials

reasons.niche_fit: A cats-only food and essentials brand maps perfectly onto cat-creator audiences, an underserved segment next to dog brands.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An established Impact program with a subscription-trial bounty structure that rewards creator-driven first orders; the evidence is directory-level rather than a creator-branded page.
reasons.compensation: 12–15% on food plus $8/15% on trials is solid for consumables with subscription repeat potential; recorded at the 12% floor.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Impact and directory listings; no published partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed as an active Impact program with a 30-day cookie; US service area only.
reasons.credibility: An established DTC pet brand with consistent reporting across two independent directories; nothing negative surfaced.

opportunity.title: Ecobee Affiliate Program via Rakuten — 6% per sale on smart thermostats, cameras and security

reasons.compensation: 6% is low in percentage terms, though ticket prices on thermostats and camera bundles soften that; no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Application via Rakuten and directory listings; no published partnerships email found on a fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is listed as active and open to apply through the network now.
reasons.credibility: A major, long-established smart-home brand owned by Generac, with products in mass retail — as checkable as brands get.

evidence.summary: Redbarn's own affiliate page (fetched via the brand's site): 'We will offer you: Free Gut Health Trial Size Variety Pack, 5% commission, 30-day cookie tracking time' and 'You earn a 5% commission on new customer sales and 3% commission on existing customer sales', with tracking links issued 'within the Impact platform'. (An older 2022 terms page on the brand's site describes a different 7%-of-profit structure and is treated as superseded by the current program page.) No earnings-cap statement and no creator count are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

opportunity.title: Redbarn Affiliate Program on Impact — 5% on new-customer sales (3% returning), 30-day cookie, free trial pack

reasons.niche_fit: Natural treats, chews and food for dogs and cats are everyday pet-creator content with strong repeat purchase behaviour.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's program page addresses bloggers, influencers and freelancers and sweetens joining with free product; evidence is the brand's own page plus directory corroboration.
reasons.compensation: 5% new / 3% returning is the lowest rate structure in this batch — the score reflects that honestly despite the free trial pack.
reasons.contact_access: Program page and Impact application route are public; no published partnerships email was found on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live on Impact with applications open now and a 30-day cookie.
reasons.credibility: Founded in 1996, widely distributed in US pet retail, with consistent program reporting across its own page and directories.

reasons.contact_access: Application through CJ and directory listings; no published partnerships email found on a fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed as active on CJ with applications open now.
